query: (EEG OR electroencephalogra*) AND ("Riemannian" OR "covariance matrices" OR "SPD matrices") AND OPEN_ACCESS:y AND PUB_YEAR:[2012 TO 2025]
verdict: DESCRIPTIVE (no threshold pre-registered). Of 20 eligible open-access covariance/Riemannian EEG studies (first 20 of the fixed Europe PMC query; 7 screened out), traps left open: centre bias 0/0 (unclear 0, not applicable 20); dependence ignored 4/19 (unclear 8, not applicable 1); pseudo-replication 0/9 (unclear 4, not applicable 11); ocular contamination 7/19 (unclear 8, not applicable 1); recording confound 1/17 (unclear 2, not applicable 3). One included study (PMC12259573) directly measures the dependence trap for the standard Riemannian MDM: accuracies differ by up to 12.7% between block-respecting and non-respecting cross-validation on n-back data. Single coder, open access only.
